annotation: The participant clenched both hands, kept the left hand still, and moved the right hand like slicing something, then moved both hands forward and pinched the fingertips
The participant placed the left hand under the right chest, with the palm facing the ceiling, and moved the right hand up and down, above the left hand
The participant placed the hands at the chests' height, with the palms facing the partner, then did the air quote with two hands
